name: Workflow Guard
description: Reusable deterministic failure thresholds, hard locks, escalation outbox, and audited staff recovery for agent workflows.
author: Evonic

variables.name: ENFORCEMENT_ENABLED
variables.label: Enable enforcement
variables.description: Apply configured hard locks; disable to retain data without enforcing.

variables.name: SHADOW_MODE
variables.label: Shadow mode
variables.description: Record qualifying outcomes without locking or overriding responses.

variables.name: ESCALATION_WEBHOOK_URL
variables.label: Escalation webhook URL
variables.description: Optional staff escalation endpoint. Pending reports remain durable when empty.

variables.name: OUTBOX_INTERVAL_SECONDS
variables.label: Outbox interval
variables.description: Seconds between pending report delivery scans.
